question: आयोजजत ककया गया था? / In November 2025, the G20 Leaders' Summit was successfully organized under the presidency of which country?

South leadership. The G20 was established in 1999 in response to global financial crises. It
comprises 21 permanent members: 19 individual nations, the European Union, and the
African Union (which was formally admitted in 2023).

question: (G7) मशखर सम्मेलन की मेजबानी की? / Which country hosted the 52nd G7 Summit in June 2026 at the scenic resort town of Évian-les-Bains?
explanation:

53वां संयुि राज्य अमेररका (2027) के श्वलए श्वनधााररत है। G7 (ग्रुप ऑफ सेवेन) एक अंतर-सरकारी राजनीश्वतक
मंि है श्वजसमें कनाडा, फ्रांस, जमानी, इटली, जापान, यूनाइटेड श्वकंगडम और संयुि राज्य अमेररका िाश्वमल हैं,
साथ ही यूरोपीय संघ एक गैर-पररगश्वर्त सदस्य के रूप में िाश्वमल है।
• France assumed the presidency to host the 52nd G7 Summit in Évian-les-Bains from June
15–17, 2026. The 51st summit was held in Kananaskis, Canada (2025), and the 53rd is slated
for the United States (2027). The G7 (Group of Seven) is an intergovernmental political
forum consisting of Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom, and the
United States, plus the European Union as a non-enumerated member.
